name: Malav Rana
headline: Frontend Engineer | React • Angular • Vue Specialist
summary: Application-focused Frontend Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable, high-performance web applications using React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, and TypeScript. Skilled in HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind, CSS Modules/Styled Components, JavaScript (ES6+), RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and front-end optimization. Experienced in fast-paced, cross-functional teams, building polished, accessible, and maintainable solutions that improve usability, reduce errors, and enhance client outcomes. Passionate about performance, testing (Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright), and modern frontend tooling (Webpack, Vite, CI/CD), thriving in enterprise environments that value quality and continuous learning.

Integrated and maintained RESTful APIs for real-time data handling and smooth client-side interaction with backend systems.
Optimized front-end performance through reusable components, efficient code structuring, and browser debugging tools to improve reliability during high-traffic live events.
Built enterprise-grade web interfaces using React, Angular, Vue, and Next.js, following modern front-end development best practices.
Developed responsive, adaptive UIs with HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and Tailwind CSS, ensuring accessibility and consistent UX across devices.
Managed client-side data manipulation and querying through RESTful APIs and GraphQL, enabling efficient communication with backend services.
Improved performance and stability through front-end optimization techniques, automated testing with Jest, and use of browser debugging tools.
Designed and implemented interactive web workflows for online pharmacy applications using React, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+).
Built and maintained client-side integrations with backend services using RESTful APIs, supporting accurate real-time updates.
Implemented form validation, state-driven UI logic, and client-side data handling to ensure reliable, user-friendly checkout experiences.
Applied performance optimization techniques (e.g., lazy loading, code splitting) to reduce load times and improve responsiveness.
Developed and deployed custom web solutions using React, Angular, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript to support donation and community engagement platforms.
Implemented RESTful API integrations and client-side data handling to deliver dynamic, real-time user experiences.
Ensured compliance with accessibility (WCAG) and responsive design principles across browsers and devices.
Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver polished, production-ready web applications.
